doc: A built fence piece (design/planner.md, Fences): its mesh, a gate's leaf and a hedge's sway as bones, collision, and guides showing its line.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres: the farthest it reaches from the origin.

fields.name: links
fields.doc: How many lattice links it built (after splitting long ones).

fields.name: joins
fields.doc: How many nodes it joined (ends, bends, junctions, towers).

fields.name: guide_lines
fields.doc: For the viewer only: line segments as pairs of points (the lattice's links and nodes, the cells it runs through, its openings).

fields.name: guide_colors
fields.doc: Each guide segment's colour, packed RGBA.

fields.name: bones
fields.doc: The moving parts, animated by house_animate_v1.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides: posts, rails, the hedge or wall solid; a gate's leaf solid.
